svg.title: Eastern Vesalius — measured regional atlas
svg.desc: A 1200 by 1600 kilometre region. Veyrasse and Serravonne on the eastern coast; Caldrienne north, Calvernis south, Karsenne inland west and Ceralte offshore east. Cressault is disputed. Railways, rivers, mountains and sea passage are marked.

g.text: O C E A N I C E X P A N S E
S O U T H E R N W A T E R S
